Prescribing items, quantity and cost from OpenPrescribing

Source: R/spending.R
op_spending.Rd

Retrieves monthly prescribing totals for one or more BNF codes, nationally or by organisation. Returns tidy data frames with one row per code, organisation and month.

Usage

op_spending(
  code,
  org_type = "national",
  org = NULL,
  date = NULL,
  by_code = TRUE,
  progress = interactive()
)

Arguments

code

Character vector of BNF codes. Any level works (section "0501", chemical "0501013B0", product, presentation); OpenPrescribing sums everything under a code prefix. Use ab_to_bnf() to obtain chemical codes from antimicrobial names.

org_type

Organisation level: "national" (all of England, default), "sicbl" (Sub-ICB Location, formerly CCG), "icb", "pcn", "practice" or "regional_team".

org

Optional organisation code(s) (for example a Sub-ICB code such as "15N" or a practice code such as "H81068"). For "practice", a Sub-ICB code returns all its practices. If NULL, all organisations of that type are returned.

date

Optional month(s) as "YYYY-MM", "YYYY-MM-DD" or Date. Required for org_type = "practice" when org is NULL (the API refuses to return every practice for every month). Several dates trigger one request per date.

by_code

If TRUE (default) one request per code and a code column; if FALSE all codes are summed by the API into one series labelled "code1+code2".

progress

Show a progress bar when several requests are needed (default: only in interactive sessions).

Value

A data frame with columns date, org_type, org_id, org_name, code, items, quantity, actual_cost (and ccg, setting for practices). items counts prescription items dispensed, quantity is in the units of each product (tablets, ml, ...) and is therefore not comparable across chemicals or formulations, actual_cost is in pounds. Months in which an organisation issued no matching item are absent (they are zeros, not missing data).

Details

The data are updated monthly with a lag of about two months. Prescribing is attributed to the practice that issued the prescription; items dispensed outside England or privately are not included.

See also

op_spending_ab() to query by antimicrobial name, op_org_details() for denominators, op_rate().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# National monthly amoxicillin items
op_spending("0501013B0")

# Co-amoxiclav in two Sub-ICB Locations
op_spending("0501013K0", org_type = "sicbl", org = c("15N", "02P"))

# All practices in one Sub-ICB, one month
op_spending("0501", org_type = "practice", org = "15N", date = "2025-03")
} # }
